notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Peregrine Drake
When Donnie & April and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
